metadata.title: Business Intelligence Mid-Semester Internal Assessment
metadata.instructions: Answer all questions to the best of your ability. Ensure your responses are concise and directly address the question asked.

questions.question_text: Define Business Intelligence and explain its relevance to decision-making processes.
questions.answer_key: Business Intelligence refers to the process of collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to inform business decisions. It is relevant because it provides insights that can guide decision-making, improve operations, and increase competitiveness. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 37)

questions.question_text: Describe the phases of the decision-making process and how Decision Support Systems (DSS) can support each phase.
questions.answer_key: The phases include intelligence, design, choice, and implementation. DSS can support these phases by providing data analysis, modeling, and simulation to inform decision-making. For example, in the intelligence phase, DSS can help identify problems or opportunities by analyzing data. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 66)

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of Automated Decision Systems and their applications.
questions.answer_key: Automated Decision Systems use artificial intelligence and machine learning to make decisions without human intervention. Applications include expert systems, decision support systems, and predictive modeling. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 38)

questions.question_text: Discuss the role of Knowledge Management and Collaborative Systems in supporting business intelligence.
questions.answer_key: Knowledge Management involves capturing, organizing, and sharing knowledge to improve decision-making. Collaborative Systems facilitate teamwork and information sharing. Together, they support business intelligence by providing a framework for data-driven decision-making and promoting a culture of collaboration and continuous learning. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 9)

questions.question_text: Describe the importance of data warehousing in business intelligence and how it supports OLAP and data mining.
questions.answer_key: Data warehousing is crucial for business intelligence as it provides a centralized repository for data, supporting OLAP (Online Analytical Processing) and data mining. This enables businesses to analyze data from multiple sources, identify patterns, and make informed decisions. (Source: CSE Scheme and Syllabus 7th _ 8th _1_.pdf, page 37)
